name: LM Studio
summary: Desktop app to download and run open models locally, now with the Bionic agent.
description: LM Studio is a desktop application for macOS, Windows and Linux that downloads and runs open-weight models on the user's own machine. It includes a chat interface and a local server compatible with the OpenAI API. Its Bionic agent can create documents, slides, PDFs and code using local or hosted models. The free plan covers local use; Bionic+ at $20 per month and Pro at $100 per month add US-hosted models and more usage.

howToUse.title: Download LM Studio
howToUse.description: Open LM Studio and download the desktop application for macOS, Windows or Linux.

howToUse.title: Run a model on your machine
howToUse.description: In the app, download an open-weight model and use the chat interface to run it locally on your machine.

howToUse.title: Create with Bionic
howToUse.description: Ask the Bionic agent to create documents, slides, PDFs or code with a local model, or switch to a hosted model for heavier work.

howToUse.title: Call the local server
howToUse.description: Turn on the local server, which is compatible with the OpenAI API, so another app on the machine can call the same model.
